Name: Touhou Mystia's Izakaya
Author: tozniz
Description:
[size=5][color=#00ffff][center]﻿Mystia's Izakaya in Stardew Valley!
夜雀食堂开到星露谷啦！[/center][center][/center]﻿
[/color][/size]本模组致力于在星露谷复刻由幽紫kk-二色幽紫蝶制作的独立游戏《东方夜雀食堂》。在此模组中，添加了来自夜雀食堂的[color=#f6b26b]28道料理[/color]、[color=#6d9eeb]6款酒水[/color]、[color=#6aa84f]11种食材[/color]，除此之外还有[color=#9900ff]1张新地图[/color]，内含[color=#e06666]4位新的NPC商店[/color]、新的[color=#3d85c6]钓鱼点与渔获[/color]（1种[color=#6fa8dc]普通鱼[/color]和1种[color=#f1c232]传说之鱼[/color]）、[color=#b6d7a8]4种新的农作物[/color]、[color=#ffe599]1种果树[/color]。拓展内容内容从《东方夜雀食堂》的本体和DLC1~5都有包含，食谱获取时期从第一年春第1日到五行精通不等，获取方式有购买、以物易物、邮件获取三种。

This mod added [color=#f6b26b]28 cuisines[/color], [color=#6d9eeb]6 beverages[/color], and [color=#6aa84f]11 ingredients [/color]from "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya" by kk, also [color=#9900ff]1 new map[/color] containing [color=#e06666]4 new NPC[/color] [color=#e06666]shops[/color], new [color=#3c78d8]fishing spots with catches[/color] ([color=#6d9eeb]1 Common Fish[/color] and [color=#f1c232]1 Legendary Fish[/color]), [color=#b6d7a8]4 new crops[/color], and [color=#ffe599]1 fruit tree[/color] . You can get the recipes by purchasing them in the shop, bartering and receiving them from mails. The date you could learn the recipes varies from Spring Day 1 of the first year to the day when you unlock the Mastery Cave.

﻿[center]﻿﻿﻿[/center]

此Mod大致基于原版的星露谷游戏平衡性，在此基础上做到前期不单一枯燥，中期拓展多样性趣味横生，后期拔高上限不超模。

This Mod is based on the original Stardew Valley game balance. I tried making it not so dry and boring in the early stage, full of diversity in the middle stage, helpful but not too strong in the last stage.

想要钓章鱼蝎鲤鱼岩浆鳗却苦手吗？试试大江户船祭！
